work.note: 303000, paragraph beginning “His career included works before the Canterbury project,” explicitly says the project began probably in the later 1380s and extended through the 1390s. Bounds retain decade precision and do not invent an exact starting year.
work.label: Later 1380s–1390s

description: Follows the pilgrims and their competing tales, examining genre, gender, social rank, authority, and the manuscript’s unfinished form. Covers The Prioress’s Tale, a Miracle and a Libel; Sir Thopas, the Host Interrupts; Melibee, Prudence and Counsel; Retraction and the Unfinished Journey.
